{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()"}
